name: 22942 · Gordonsville, VA
findings: ZIP 22942 (Gordonsville) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22942 (Gordonsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
